LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingTalkOnAir: Colonists talk on the radio by themselves
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingTalkOnAirDesc: Colonists with a hand-held in touch chat with each other across the map now and then, most often when working alone; in the evening, someone at home calls a partner, family member or friend who is away in a caravan; and at night, someone keeps a colonist in bed, or one working alone, company on the radio. Each leaves a memory, and chats show in the social log. A colonist's hand-held lights the station's lamp only while they are really talking. On by default.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioTalk_CouldNotGetThrough: {CALLER} tried to call {AWAY} this evening and couldn't get through.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioTalk_CompanyInBed: {OTHER} kept {COLONIST} company on the radio through the night, as they lay in bed.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioTalk_CompanyAtWork: {OTHER} kept {COLONIST} company on the radio as they worked alone through the night.
